name: Wiesbrook Sheet Metal HVAC
old_description: YOUR TRUSTED PARTNER FOR HVAC AND ARCHITECTURAL METAL SOLUTIONS
about:
Wiesbrook Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded in 1989 in Plainfield, Illinois, with the goal of becoming the leading sheet metal contractor in northeastern Illinois. The company remains privately held; no specific ownership designation such as family- or veteran-owned is stated in its public materials.

The firm operates as a full-service sheet metal fabricator and HVAC contractor. Its shop produces custom sheet metal components for architectural and mechanical systems, while its field teams handle residential and commercial HVAC installation, maintenance, and 24/7 emergency repair. The company reports a staff of over 50 skilled professionals and more than 10,000 completed projects across the western Chicago suburbs.

Wiesbrook serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers throughout communities such as Naperville, Aurora, Joliet, and St. Charles. It is an authorized dealer for Armstrong Air heating and cooling equipment and works on projects ranging from ductless heat-pump retrofits to large-scale commercial ductwork.

The company emphasizes its breadth of capability—combining architectural metal fabrication with comprehensive HVAC service under one roof—as a key differentiator in the Chicagoland market. Its stated core values center on quality, customer-first service, innovation, and long-term community commitment.
